label: Theta.8 controls: heavenly first, contingent first, idle uncaused composite, checked
description: Controls for the Theta.8 routes. HeavenlyFirst: the Theta.8 substance premises leave a first being in potency to a place. ContingentFirst: 8288ff1e does not imply first-being incorruptibility. RestrictedStrict and Facts: the restricted composition premise is strictly weaker, and equivalent given STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING. IdleUncausedComposite: an interpretation satisfies every premise of the composition, Theta.8 and plenitude-plus-change-cause routes except the cause of composites and plenitude, with a composite, uncaused first being in potency to a place it never actualizes; it shows only that rejecting {ca07cae9, plenitude} suffices. The minimal rejection sets for a first being in potency (one premise of each route; rejecting d8024a38 also rejects 3d99779b, which implies it) are: {e078f07b}; {x, y} with x one of ca07cae9, e0088de9, d8024a38 and y one of b9baf50d, d256e6d2, 7371403f, 966c08c6; {a, b, y} with a one of 8288ff1e, 3d99779b and b one of ca55ed3a, d017b6b0. Rejecting 3d99779b alone does not suffice, since the Theta.8 route survives through d8024a38. The strong act-priority readings are further routes not counted here. ThetaEightOmissions and PlenitudeOmissions: each premise of both new routes is needed; the plenitude route has a nonvacuous witness. Model-witnessed and general implications only; no interpretation is claimed metaphysically possible.
